author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
If you've ever opened an invoice and manually retyped the vendor, the date, and the total into some other system, you know exactly how tedious that gets. In this video, in partnership with UiPath, you’ll see how to build an orchestration that does that reading (and the typing) for you, using UiPath Maestro Flow. ⭐Check out how Maestro Flow can save you time: https://www.uipath.com/product/maestro/flow

Flow is a canvas inside UiPath where you connect a few steps, called nodes, to build an orchestration — no code required. In this example you’ll see a Flow built start to finish, where a document comes in, an agent reads it and pulls out the details that matter, a person checks the result before anything's final, and the clean data gets saved to a spreadsheet. 

And it doesn't have to be an invoice — the same approach works for a receipt, a form, pretty much any document with a few consistent fields.
